source_metadata.etymology_text:
Inherited from Old Czech podzim, created as pod- + zima. Cognate with Lower Sorbian nazyma (via Proto-Slavic *zima).
Also compare Persian پاییز (pâyiz, “autumn”) (< Proto-Iranian *pati- (“against”) + *jimáh (“winter”)) (cognate via Proto-Indo-European *ǵʰéyōm).
